answer: What keeps this honest is Endorsed sports reporter match file with sports journalists confirmation, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 504 pays 7560 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The cipher of the design is public, the thread of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the echo of honest work is what finally pays. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
